ability.name: Lightshard of the Harvest Moon
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Nighthaunt^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Mirror of Echoing Failures
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, for the rest of the phase:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the targets.
• Each time any of the targets fails to cast a spell or chant a prayer, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
ability.declare: Pick each enemy **^^Wizard^^** and ^^**Priest^^** within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

ability.name: Brazier of Nagashizzar
ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

ability.name: Stave of Suffering
ability.effect: While this unit is within 12" of any damaged enemy units or enemy units that have had any models slain, add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^Nighthaunt^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Tombstone of the Penitent
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for each non-**^^Faction Terrain^^** terrain feature that is being contested by friendly units, to a maximum of 8.

ability.name: Amulet of Waking Nightmares
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target cannot be affected by the ‘Guarded Hero’ ability or the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** within 18" of this unit to be the target.
